description: Optima of the two-spin coupling search, used as inputs by the analysis notebooks and the L=11 warm start. Canonical-frame vectors are x = [J, XX, YY, XY+YX, XZ+ZX, YZ+ZY] with h = 1 and g = 0; the standard frame additionally has YZ+ZY = 0 and XZ+ZX > 0.

L9.min1_note: Min 1 (Newton): the refined L-BFGS-B optimum of notebook 03, rounded to 6 decimals. Phi = 7.154433e-02. The unrounded optimum (as regenerated by notebook 03 with the default BLAS thread count) is used only for the coupling-space Hessian in notebook 04, as in the original analysis.
L9.min2_note: Min 2 (DE, J fixed at J_PRX): Phi = 7.031195e-02. The 4-decimal couplings (with J = J_PRX) are the point used for the J-direction scan and the full 6D Hessian in notebook 04.

L11.note: Standard-frame optima at 6 significant figures, as used for the level-spacing statistics in notebook 05.
